name: Artificer Infusion
description: 5e Artificer Infusion entity definition specifying prerequisites, item targets, attunement requirements, description, and granted modifiers.

name.description: Name of the infusion (e.g. 'Enhanced Defense', 'Repeating Shot', 'Replicate Magic Item').

prerequisite.description: Prerequisite needed to learn this infusion (e.g. '6th-level artificer', null for none).

item_type.description: Item type that this infusion can be applied to (e.g. 'A suit of armor or a shield', 'A simple or martial weapon with the ammunition property').

attunement.description: Whether the infused item requires attunement while infused.

description.description: Complete rules text and mechanical effects of the infusion.

benefits.description: Bullet points summarizing key mechanical benefits.

grants_modifiers.description: Modifiers granted to the item or wearer when this infusion is active.

replicated_item.description: For Replicate Magic Item infusions, the target magic item name or reference.
